controls.positive: An empty room, no people. Hand-painted anime film background of a dark timber illustration room looking onto a blossom courtyard after rain. The left half and centre of the frame is a plain dark plum-toned plaster wall, almost empty and low in detail. At the right edge an open wooden sliding window frames a cherry tree in full blossom in a wet stone courtyard, a few petals drifting outside the window only; a low ink-stained timber desk with blank paper beneath it. Plum, dusty rose and warm dark timber palette, restrained botanical atmosphere. An empty room with nobody in it. Fixed eye-level camera, calm and quiet, hand-painted cel anime film background art. No text, no signs, no logos, no characters, no people, no figures.
